units.source_text: 独臂大仙立刻吹了一声口哨，接着一条黑色的狗出现在他脚下。

en.t: The one-armed immortal immediately whistled, and then a black dog appeared at his feet.

units.source_text: 独臂大仙接着说：“它的名字叫阿飞，不管是什么地方，你骑在它的背上都能到达。

en.t: The one-armed immortal went on, "Its name is Afei. Wherever the place may be, if you ride on its back, you can get there.

units.source_text: 明天我的弟弟估计也会来对你表达谢意吧。”

en.t: Tomorrow, my younger brother will probably come too and express his thanks to you."

units.source_text: 话音刚落，他也和昨天的独脚大仙一样消失的无影无踪了。

en.t: As soon as he finished speaking, he too vanished without a trace, just like the one-legged immortal from yesterday.
